Markets.title: US Federal Reserve’s Anna Paulson sees scope for more interest rate hikes amid inflation risks
Markets.summary: Philadelphia Federal Reserve President Anna Paulson stated that further interest rate hikes may be needed because inflation remains persistently high at around 2.5 to 3 percent. She described the US economy as relatively strong despite external pressures from tariffs and the conflict in the Middle East.

Markets.title: Snapdeal parent AceVector raises Rs 189 crore from anchors; Negen, Singularity among top investors
Markets.summary: Snapdeal parent company AceVector raised Rs 189 crore from anchor investors for its upcoming initial public offering. The IPO opens on September 25 with a price range of Rs 30 to Rs 32 per share.

Markets.title: Sebi revamps accredited investors framework; approves common ad code for mkt intermediaries
Markets.summary: Sebi expanded the definition of accredited investors and approved a common advertisement code that permits celebrity brand endorsements while restricting specific product ads. Additionally, the agency introduced a new settlement scheme for non-genuine trades in illiquid stock options.

Markets.title: Sebi clears PRIM route for PMS players to invest in mutual funds, SIFs; Rs 25 lakh minimum ticket
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has approved the PRIM framework, allowing portfolio managers to invest client funds in direct mutual fund plans, ETFs, index funds, and SIFs. This new investment route requires a minimum ticket size of Rs 25 lakh and broadens portfolio management services beyond direct equities.

Markets.title: HDFC MF bets on PB Fintech, buys stake worth Rs 321 crore as IRDAI reforms trigger 36% stock rout
Markets.summary: HDFC Mutual Fund purchased 2.5 million shares of PB Fintech for approximately Rs 321 crore. The investment came despite a 36% drop in the company's stock price caused by proposed IRDAI insurance commission caps.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets suffered a sharp selloff on Friday, with the Sensex plunging 1,248 points and the Nifty dropping 1.6%. The downturn was driven by surging US Treasury yields, high crude oil prices, and escalating geopolitical tensions, with financial stocks leading the losses.

Geo-Political.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
Geo-Political.summary: The White House restored press access for CNN, Politico, and MS NOW after previously banning their staff. This reversal followed a judge's order against the Trump administration's restrictions.

Geo-Political.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
Geo-Political.summary: Australia announced an OpenAI data breach at the United Nations. This disclosure comes as the country implements strict social media restrictions and proposes new controls on technology.

Geo-Political.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
Geo-Political.summary: Four civilians were killed in Afghanistan during airstrikes conducted by Pakistan. Pakistan stated that it targeted 10 military objectives during the operation.

Geo-Political.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
Geo-Political.summary: A priest was killed and four other people were injured in a knife attack at an abbey in the Polish town of Jarosław. Police arrested a male suspect from Ukraine in connection with the stabbings.

Geo-Political.title: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
Geo-Political.summary: Italian ministers agreed to ban the burqa and niqab in schools. They also approved a cap on the number of foreign students in classrooms.

Geo-Political.title: Rapper Macklemore announces 'Free Palestine' tour after Ed Sheeran fallout
Geo-Political.summary: Rapper Macklemore has announced a "Free Palestine" tour starting in Dublin next month following a fallout with Ed Sheeran. He stated that the proceeds from the tour will be donated to organizations that support Palestinians.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator successfully generated free organic traffic after ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result. This discovery highlights the growing shift toward optimizing content for AI platforms rather than traditional search engines.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries in 2023. These tools automate repetitive tasks to improve workflows, increase productivity, and handle natural language applications.

Data & Insights.title: India-Mexico may sign trade pact, report reveals: Autos, pharma, engineering—who stands to gain?
Data & Insights.summary: India and Mexico plan to finalize terms for a preferential trade agreement in early October to improve market access and trade. The pact is expected to boost Indian exports, particularly in automobiles, pharmaceuticals, and engineering, despite upcoming tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund loans cross  ₹1 trillion as Centre targets post-harvest efficiency
Data & Insights.summary: Loans under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund have surpassed ₹1 trillion as the Centre aims to boost post-harvest efficiency. Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Gujarat are the top five beneficiary states, with individual farmers accounting for nearly 59% of approved ventures.

Data & Insights.title: Centre cuts import duty on edible oils to curb price rise
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has reduced import duties on edible oils to lower incoming costs. This policy change aims to decrease retail cooking oil prices for consumers.

Data & Insights.title: PM’s principal secretary flags risks from trade barriers, volatile capital
Data & Insights.summary: India's principal secretary Pramod Kumar Mishra warned that the country cannot depend on favorable global conditions despite its economic stability and growth. He specifically highlighted potential risks from rising trade barriers and volatile capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: Rupee has a fair case to appreciate: RBI DG Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta states that the rupee's recent depreciation is likely temporary. She attributes this to India's strong underlying balance of payments, creating a fair case for the currency to appreciate.

Data & Insights.title: Flash PMI: Business activity hits three-month high in September on robust manufacturing demand
Data & Insights.summary: Middle East tensions prompted companies to build record inventory buffers, helping business activity reach a three-month high in September due to robust manufacturing demand. Additionally, rising output prices signaled renewed efforts by firms to safeguard their profit margins.

India.title: Drive Through Tollgates: New Rules For High-Speed Highways
India.summary: The National Highways Authority of India has introduced new guidelines to implement barrier-free tolling on high-speed highways. The updated rules also focus on smarter traffic planning, improved drainage systems, and the creation of greener corridors.

India.title: Bay Of Bengal Depression To Bring Heavy Rain To Bengal, Odisha And Other States
India.summary: The India Meteorological Department warns that a new depression over the Bay of Bengal will bring heavy to very heavy rainfall starting Friday. West Bengal, Odisha, and several other states are expected to be affected by the severe weather.

India.title: DMK Didn't Try To Shield Granite Baron Accused In Sex Abuse Case: MK Stalin
India.summary: DMK leader MK Stalin stated that granite baron R Veeramani and anyone who protected him must face the law for a sex abuse case. He added that all accused should receive the maximum punishment regardless of their positions.

India.title: Woman Alleges Her Photo Was Morphed During CJP Protests, Case Filed
India.summary: A woman filed a police case alleging that her photograph was digitally altered using AI and face-swap technology to superimpose it onto an image of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The alleged photo manipulation occurred during protests organized by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP).

India.title: Opinion: Blog: 20 Years On, My LSR Memories Of Harassment Have Not Faded
India.summary: Two decades later, the author reflects on enduring memories of harassment from her time at Lady Shri Ram College. She argues that restricting women's access to public spaces does not solve the underlying problem of safety on the streets.

India.title: Barmer MLA Ravindra Bhati Plans 5-Day March For Bigger Footprint In Rajasthan
India.summary: Barmer MLA Ravindra Singh Bhati plans to lead a five-day march across Rajasthan to expand his political influence. Bhati already has a significant online presence, including millions of followers across Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter.

General.title: Watch: Why has Trump been so eager to welcome Xi?
General.summary: BBC reporter Sarah Smith examines why President Donald Trump has eagerly anticipated Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit for months. The video report explores the strategic reasons behind Trump's warm welcome of the Chinese leader.

General.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
General.summary: The White House restored press access for media outlets previously banned by the Trump administration following a judge's order. However, lawyers for CNN, Politico, and MS Now are now seeking an emergency hearing, alleging the White House repeatedly violated that order.

General.title: Watch: UN delegates walk out of Netanyahu speech
General.summary: United Nations delegates walked out of a speech delivered by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Meanwhile, members of the Israeli delegation remained in the room cheering in support of his address.

General.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
General.summary: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

General.title: Man jailed for two years over throwing bottle at Portsmouth migrant protest
General.summary: Del Somerville, 42, was sentenced to two years in prison after pleading guilty to violent disorder. He threw a bottle during an overnight migrant protest in Eastney.

General.title: 'We are living a constant nightmare,' mother of poison seller victim tells hearing
General.summary: Tanya Whitaker testified at a hearing about the devastating impact of her son Samuel's death. Samuel died after consuming a poison sold online by Kenneth Law.
